company_name: Shenzhen Shenkeda Semiconductor Technology Co., LTD.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in semiconductor testing and sorting equipment, which is critical for the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: Shenzhen Shenkeda Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. is focused on the R&D, manufacturing, sales, and technical services of semiconductor testing and sorting equipment. With a strong R&D team and a significant portfolio of patents, the company is positioned to provide advanced solutions in the semiconductor testing domain.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Shenzhen, China, and is part of the Shenzhen S-king Group.
